name: Garden of Ancients

start.dialog: The flowers here are so unique! I'm trying to cultivate a garden of ancient species. But I need special soil from the highest peaks. Would you help me gather some?
start.objective: Collect ancient soil from three different high peaks in the Uplands

progress.dialog: The soil needs to be from untouched places. Where the ancients walked. Can you feel the difference?
progress.objective: Continue gathering soil from sacred high places

complete.dialog: This soil... it's perfect! I can feel the ancient whispers in it. Thank you. Here - a staff carved from the World Tree. It will help you hear what the planet is saying.

party_comments.kade: She talks to flowers. And they seem to listen.
party_comments.renna: She has an innate connection to the Growth Foundation. Rare gift.
party_comments.suresh: One with nature. A kindred spirit.

hidden_outcome: If you bring soil from a fourth 'forbidden' peak, Aeris grows a special flower that grants 'Holy' magic when carried
